about: Focus handoff between Elden Ring and Minecraft's invisible input window. Source of truth for the remix's change; code is built from these rows.

rows.trigger: every bridge tick while Elden Ring is the foreground window and mcPid is known
rows.behavior: AllowSetForegroundWindow(mcPid), so Minecraft's SetForegroundWindow is not refused by Windows
rows.limit: only Minecraft's own process id, only while Elden Ring is foreground
rows.verified: compiles with mingw-w64; in-game: needs player test

rows.trigger: overlay turns on (world entered) or F8 return
rows.behavior: SetForegroundWindow on Minecraft's window; report success only when GetForegroundWindow is that window
rows.limit: Overlay retries every 250 ms for at most 10 s, so Alt+Tab to another app is not fought
rows.verified: compiles with Gradle; in-game: needs player test

rows.trigger: F8 pressed while Elden Ring is foreground (mcSwitchReq bump)
rows.behavior: bring Minecraft back and focus it even when it never handed control away (lost focus without F8)
rows.verified: compiles with Gradle; in-game: needs player test
